original_text:
这20个大体上都是ok的。现在module库是怎样的情况？
回到我现在的情况。我现在需要的是探索出一个稳定的方法论，供后续不断创作。然后先把平原做好（只有反冲）。

interpretation.current_goal: A repeatable content-production method tested with concrete demand adaptation, then a good recoil-only plains region.
interpretation.mechanism_scope: Enemies, bells, carriers and hazards remain available; no extra player movement unlocks.
interpretation.production_priority: Consolidate versioned candidate store and capability/role selection; validate content recipes across spatial demands rather than inflate distinct-family counts.

approval_note: Overall positive visual feedback; no invented individual rating or manual-play evidence.
